baseline-test-a.woff2, baseline-test-b.woff2, baseline-test-c.woff2
============================================

Subsets of open fonts, cut down to the characters of the baseline fixtures (plus "Hg", the probe the export
measures natural line height with) and renamed, as the
license below requires for a modified font:

  baseline-test-a.woff2  "Docxodus Baseline Test A", from Carlito Regular (Debian fonts-crosextra-carlito,
                         SHA-256 of the source TTF below). Carlito shares Calibri's metrics.
  baseline-test-b.woff2  "Docxodus Baseline Test B", from Liberation Sans Regular (Debian fonts-liberation).
                         Liberation Sans shares Arial's metrics.
  baseline-test-c.woff2  "Docxodus Baseline Test C", from Liberation Serif Regular (Debian fonts-liberation).
                         Liberation Serif shares Times New Roman's metrics; used for exact line spacing.

They exist so the exported-baseline test (tests/export-line-baselines.spec.ts, issue #908) lays its
fixture out with Calibri's and Arial's vertical metrics on any machine, without installing fonts
system-wide. Subsetting keeps the hhea and OS/2 metrics the test depends on. Built with:

  pyftsubset <source.ttf> --text="HgCASE0123456789 The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while
    the editor counts every line. raised" --flavor=woff2 --no-hinting --name-IDs='*'

then renaming name IDs 1, 3, 4, 6 and 16 with fontTools. Docxodus itself remains MIT-licensed. Only these
font files carry the terms below, and they are test fixtures: not part of any published package.

  Carlito:         Copyright (c) 2010-2013 by tyPoland Lukasz Dziedzic with Reserved Font Name "Carlito".
  Liberation Sans / Serif: Digitized data copyright (c) 2010 Google Corporation with Reserved Font Arimo, Tinos
                   and Cousine. Copyright (c) 2012 Red Hat, Inc. with Reserved Font Name Liberation.

  4659bc0c58c5028dd488ec928d41d9265db43d9b669fc14ca8b0832daca7b144  /usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf
  705903ae1382f0150f115d6f10a30f5b2f3d6ade649c474afe6366c39174fb65  /usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSerif-Regular.ttf
